summary: BI-ED52AB82 (agent dialog broker item C, spec 2026-10-27 §6.7). Migration 20261112000000_mcp_room_resource_subscriptions adds McpResourceSubscription (one row per MCP client and room resource, so a resources/subscribe on one portal process is heard by a GET stream on another) and an AFTER INSERT trigger on WorkItemMessage that sends pg_notify('dpf_room_message') with the message's workItemId, messageId and createdAt. The notice carries no message content and is delivered only on commit.
affectedCopies: McpResourceSubscription rows: written only by resources/subscribe (upsert) and resources/unsubscribe (delete) in apps/web/lib/mcp/room-resources.server.ts; an open GET stream extends its subscriber's rows (apps/web/lib/mcp/task-status-stream.ts); read by the fan-out in apps/web/lib/mcp/room-update-fanout.server.ts. Rows cascade away with their WorkItem.
WorkItemMessage: unchanged columns; every insert now also queues one pg_notify on dpf_room_message, heard by each portal process's shared LISTEN connection.

privacyAssessment.sensitivity: internal: an opaque subscriber key (OAuth refresh-family or credential id), a room URI and case key, and the room's work item id. No message text, no names, no contact data.
privacyAssessment.dataSubjectRights: No content about a person. A subscription is keyed by a credential, not a person, and is removed by unsubscribe, by expiry or with its room.
privacyAssessment.reviewDisposition: Ephemeral operational state; the retention sweep purges rows two days past expiresAt.

migration.name: 20261112000000_mcp_room_resource_subscriptions
migration.backfill: None. The table starts empty; the trigger fires on new inserts only.
migration.rollback: Forward-only and additive. Dropping the trigger stops live push (pull via read_room_messages is unaffected); dropping the table removes subscriptions, which clients recreate with resources/subscribe.

changes.lifecycleDisposition: Ephemeral: lapses 24 h after the last subscribe or stream open; purged 2 days past expiresAt; cascades with its WorkItem.

fields.reason: Opaque auth-context key: family:<oauthFamilyKey> or token:<credential id>. Not a person identifier.
The room's case key, e.g. backlog-item:BI-ED52AB82.
Foreign key to the room's WorkItem; governed by the WorkItem asset.
